title: Tea5767-Radio-Tuner
summary: A simple Arduino library/project for controlling the TEA5767 FM radio module, allowing users to tune to different radio frequencies. The project enables microcontrollers to interface with this popular low-cost FM receiver chip for building radio projects.
problem_solved: Provides an easy interface to control TEA5767 FM radio module frequency tuning from Arduino
why_valuable: Enables hobbyists and makers to add FM radio functionality to their embedded projects with minimal complexity
